name: Rename a variable across a file
prompt: In src/config.rs, rename the field category_labels to display_names throughout the file — the struct field, the constructor, and the method that uses it. Make sure the tests still pass after the rename.
expected_behavior: Agent renames category_labels to display_names in the struct definition, in default_config(), and in category_display_name(). Then verifies tests pass.
success_criteria: All 3 occurrences of category_labels renamed to display_names
